tasks.label: Chord: собрать и запустить
tasks.command: call "C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/18/Insiders/VC/Auxiliary/Build/vcvarsall.bat" x64 >nul && (if not exist "build" mkdir "build") && cl /nologo /W4 /utf-8 /DUNICODE /D_UNICODE /Zi /FS src\Windows\*.c /Fobuild\ /Fdbuild\ /Fe:build\chord.exe && echo [OK] build\chord.exe && build\chord.exe
